FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
(Chairman, District Committee for selection of outsourcing agencies)
Notification No.02/WCD/2026 Dated: 05.10.2026
Sub: Outsourcing – Selection of an agency for engagement of personnel in the Sakhi One
Stop Centre, the Child Helpline 1098 and the Government Children Home, Jangaon
– Written test on Sunday, the 11th October 2026 – Notification issued.
Ref: 1. G.O.Rt.No.2501, Finance (SMPC) Department, dated 13.07.2006.
2. G.O.Rt.No.4459, Finance (SMPC) Department, dated 27.12.2006, and Circular
Memo No.8999-A/319/A2/SMPC/2007, dated 21.04.2007.
3. G.O.Rt.No.4271, Finance (SMPC) Department, dated 01.11.2008.
4. Government Memo No.1968/Prog.I/1/2023, dated 29.08.2023 of the Department
for Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens.
5. Memo No.2062/CH/2022, dated 19.08.2026 of the Director, Women
Development and Child Welfare, Hyderabad.
6. Memorandum of Understanding dated 24.07.2025 between the Director, Women
Development and Child Welfare, and the State level agency for the Children Homes.
* * *
1. One agency will be selected to engage, on outsourcing basis, the personnel of the three
wings shown below, which work under the District Welfare Officer, Jangaon.
Applications are invited from eligible agencies.
Sl.No. Wing and scheme Posts Monthly remuneration at
present
1 Sakhi One Stop Centre (Mission Shakti) 13 About Rs.1.85 lakh
2 Child Helpline 1098 (Mission Vatsalya) 8 About Rs.1.52 lakh
3 Government Children Home (Mission Vatsalya) 6 As per the norms of the
scheme
2. The personnel are selected by the Collector by written examination and oral test. The
agency has no part in their selection, continuance or removal. Its work is to engage the
persons so selected, pay their remuneration, remit the statutory contributions and keep
the records.
3. The engagement of the agency is for one year from the date of agreement. It may be
extended by one year on satisfactory performance. For the Child Helpline it takes effect
from the date on which the present arrangement ends, as ordered by the Collector.
4. The commission is fixed at 2.50 per cent of the remuneration paid in the month, which
is the rate in the Memorandum of Understanding sixth cited. No financial bid is called
for. The contributions of the employer to EPF and ESI, and GST, will be reimbursed as
per the orders of the Government in force, on proof of remittance. Nothing else is
payable to the agency.
5. An agency is eligible only if it satisfies all the following conditions on the date of this
notification.
1
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6260/2026COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6272/2026
(a) It is a proprietary concern, partnership firm, company or society registered under
the law, is registered under the Telangana Shops and Establishments Act 1988,
and has completed three years.
(b) It has supplied personnel on outsourcing basis to offices of the Government, or to
bodies under the Government, without break for the last three years, and not less
than 25 such persons are on its rolls in the EPF return for August 2026. The
agreements or work orders and the electronic challan cum return of the EPF
Organisation are the proof. A certificate of the office served will not be accepted
by itself.
(c) It holds code numbers of its own under the Employees Provident Funds and
Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952 and the Employees State Insurance Act 1948,
and has remitted the contributions for every month from September 2025 to
August 2026.
(d) It holds a licence in force under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition)
Act 1970, GST registration and PAN, and has filed income tax returns for the last
three assessment years and GST returns up to August 2026.
(e) It has not been blacklisted or debarred by any department or body of the
Government. No order of damages or recovery for default under the EPF or ESI
law is outstanding against it. No criminal case relating to its business is pending
against its proprietor, partners or directors.
(f) It has a working office in Jangaon District, or undertakes to open one within
fifteen days of selection.
(g) It furnishes a solvency certificate of a scheduled bank for not less than
Rs.10,00,000, issued on or after 01.09.2026.
(h) It furnishes earnest money of Rs.25,000 by demand draft drawn in favour of the
Collector, Jangaon. No certificate or exemption will be accepted in place of the
demand draft. The earnest money of agencies not selected will be returned.
(i) Neither the proprietor nor any partner, director or office bearer is a near relative
of an employee of the office of the District Welfare Officer, Jangaon, or of any
person engaged in the three wings. Agencies under common ownership or
management shall file one application. Where more than one is filed, all will be
rejected.
6. Selection will be on a total of 200 marks. The agency with the highest total will be
selected. Where the total is equal, the agency with more marks in the written test will
be placed higher. The next two agencies will be kept on a reserve list for one year.
Sl.No. Component Marks
1 Written test of the person who will sign the agreement 100
2 Record of compliance, on the scale in Annexure II 75
3 Oral test before the Committee 25
7. The written test will be taken by the proprietor, the managing partner or a director of
the agency, being the person who will sign the agreement. No other representative will
be admitted. The test carries 100 objective questions for 60 minutes, in English and
Telugu, each with five options and one mark. One fourth of a mark will be deducted for
2
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6260/2026COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6272/2026
every wrong answer. Answers are marked on an OMR sheet. The syllabus is in
Annexure II. In the oral test the same person will answer five questions drawn from a
question bank, each marked out of five on a scoring sheet. The oral test will be held and
the selection declared on the day of the written test.

9. Applications in the form in Annexure I, with the documents listed in it, page numbered
and signed, and the demand draft, shall be handed over in a sealed cover superscribed
with the number of this notification at the Inward Section of the Collectorate, Integrated
District Offices Complex, Jangaon, from 06.10.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM
on working days and between 10.30 AM and 1.00 PM on Saturday, the 10.10.2026. An
admission slip in the name of the person who will take the test will be issued across the
counter. Admission to the test is provisional. The Committee will scrutinise the
documents and verify them on the portals before the test, and the marks for the record
of compliance will be announced with the result. Applications will not be received at
the office of the District Welfare Officer or in any wing.
10. The following terms bind the agency selected and form part of the agreement.
(a) It shall pay the remuneration in full into the bank account of each person on or
before the 5th of the following month, whether or not it has received the
reimbursement for that month, to the extent of the bills of two months.
(b) It shall deduct only the contribution of the employee to EPF and ESI and the
professional tax. Any other deduction, or collection of money from the personnel
in any form, will lead to termination, forfeiture of the performance security and
blacklisting under G.O.Rt.No.4271, besides criminal action.
(c) It shall remit the EPF and ESI contributions within the due date and produce the
challans and the bank statement of payment of remuneration with the bill of the
following month. No bill will be admitted without them.
3
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6260/2026COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6272/2026
(d) It shall give a wage slip to each person every month, keep the registers required
by the labour laws and produce them on demand.
(e) It shall not discontinue or replace any person except on the written orders of the
Collector.
(f) It shall furnish, before the agreement, performance security of Rs.5,00,000 by
bank guarantee valid for fourteen months, being about one month of remuneration
of the posts covered.
(g) It shall obtain the licence under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition)
Act 1970 for this work within thirty days of the agreement.
(h) For every day of delay in payment of remuneration beyond the 5th, one tenth of
the commission of the month will be forfeited. A second delay within a year is a
ground for termination.
(i) The Collector may end the engagement on one month of notice. The agency may
withdraw on two months of notice.
(j) Complaints of the personnel will be heard by the Additional Collector (Revenue),
who is in charge of the grievance cell under G.O.Rt.No.4271.
11. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the agency. An agency that furnishes a false
document or suppresses any fact will be rejected at any stage, its earnest money or
security forfeited, and it will be blacklisted. The Collector may modify or cancel this
notification. The decision of the Committee is final. The key, results and notices will be
placed on the district website https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board
of the Collectorate.
Sd/-

OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
Notification No.02/WCD/2026, dated 05.10.2026
Applications are invited from eligible agencies for selection of one outsourcing agency to
engage the personnel of the Sakhi One Stop Centre (13 posts), the Child Helpline 1098 (8
posts) and the Government Children Home (6 posts), Jangaon, for one year. The commission
is fixed at 2.50 per cent of the remuneration. Selection is on a written test of the proprietor,
managing partner or director on Sunday, 11.10.2026, from 1.00 PM to 2.00 PM, the record of
remittance of EPF, ESI and GST, and an oral test on the same day. Earnest money is
Rs.25,000. Applications in the prescribed form will be received in sealed cover at the Inward
Section of the Collectorate, IDOC, Jangaon, from 06.10.2026 up to 1.00 PM on 10.10.2026.
The conditions of eligibility, the terms and the form of application are in the detailed
notification on https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the Collectorate.
Collector and District Magistrate, Jangaon
